name: mk_locked_explicit
spec: "locked": the account is locked, disabled or suspended, or there were too many (failed) sign-in attempts ("Your account has been locked", "Account locked", "too many failed attempts", "temporarily disabled").

name: mk_locked_too_many_attempts
text: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in 30 minutes.
spec: "locked": the account is locked, disabled or suspended, or there were too many (failed) sign-in attempts ("Your account has been locked", "Account locked", "too many failed attempts", "temporarily disabled").

name: mk_locked_case_insensitive
spec: text = the error / alert messages the tenant shows on the sign-in or create-account page (may be empty). Case-insensitive. First matching rule wins: ... "locked": the account is locked, disabled or suspended ...

name: mk_exists_already_in_use
text: This email address is already in use.
spec: "exists": an account with this e-mail already exists ("already exists", "already in use", "already registered", "is already associated with an account", "An account with this email address already exists").

name: mk_exists_associated_with_account
text: The email address is already associated with an account.
spec: "exists": an account with this e-mail already exists ("already exists", "already in use", "already registered", "is already associated with an account", "An account with this email address already exists").

name: mk_wrong_password_sign_in_failed_check_email
text: Sign in failed: check your email and password
spec: "Sign in failed: check your email and password" counts as wrong_password, not verify.

name: mk_wrong_password_no_account
text: We could not sign you in: account doesn't exist
spec: "wrong_password": the e-mail / username / password / credentials are wrong, invalid, incorrect or not recognised; "could not sign you in"; "no account" / "account doesn't exist" ...

name: mk_verify_before_sign_in
text: Please verify your account before you sign in
spec: "verify": the tenant asks to verify / activate the account or e-mail, or to check the inbox for a verification e-mail ("Please verify your account before you sign in", "We sent you a verification email", "Activate your account").

name: mk_verify_mail_sent
text: We sent you a verification email
spec: "verify": the tenant asks to verify / activate the account or e-mail, or to check the inbox for a verification e-mail ("Please verify your account before you sign in", "We sent you a verification email", "Activate your account").

name: mk_none_empty_text
spec: "none": empty text or anything else ("Sign In", "Loading", "Required", "Something went wrong").

name: fc_locked_beats_verify_mail_and_created
spec: Rules, in order; the first that holds wins: 1. "locked" — error is "locked".

name: fc_locked_beats_exists_msg
spec: Rules, in order; the first that holds wins: 1. "locked" — error is "locked".

name: fc_old_account_via_exists_msg
spec: 2. "old_account" — the candidate's own earlier account, which the Keychain passwords do not open: exists_msg is true, OR there is an "other" mail dated before agent_since and no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since.

name: fc_old_account_via_other_mail_before_agent_since
spec: 2. "old_account" — ... OR there is an "other" mail dated before agent_since and no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since.

name: fc_agent_account_verify_mail_on_agent_since
spec: 3. "agent_account_password" — a "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since exists (the agent created this account) and error is "wrong_password". ... A date equal to agent_since counts as on/after it.

name: fc_agent_account_verify_after_with_other_before
spec: 2. "old_account" — ... there is an "other" mail dated before agent_since and no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since. / 3. "agent_account_password" — a "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since exists (the agent created this account) and error is "wrong_password".

name: fc_agent_account_verify_banner_with_verify_mail
spec: 3. "agent_account_password" — a "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since exists (the agent created this account) and error is "wrong_password".

name: fc_no_verify_mail_created_wrong_password
spec: 4. "no_verify_mail" — created is true, there is no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since, and error is "wrong_password" or "none" or verify_banner is true: a new account whose verification e-mail never came.

name: fc_no_verify_mail_verify_mail_only_before_agent_since
spec: 4. "no_verify_mail" — created is true, there is no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since, and error is "wrong_password" or "none" or verify_banner is true: a new account whose verification e-mail never came.

name: fc_no_verify_mail_beats_no_answer_via_verify_banner
spec: 4. "no_verify_mail" — created is true, there is no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since, and error is "wrong_password" or "none" or verify_banner is true: a new account whose verification e-mail never came.

name: fc_old_account_beats_no_verify_mail
spec: 2. "old_account" — the candidate's own earlier account, which the Keychain passwords do not open: ... OR there is an "other" mail dated before agent_since and no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since.

name: fc_old_account_beats_no_answer
spec: 2. "old_account" — the candidate's own earlier account, which the Keychain passwords do not open: ... there is an "other" mail dated before agent_since and no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since.

name: fc_no_answer_created_false_error_none
spec: 5. "no_answer" — error is "none" (the tenant gave no recognisable answer).

name: fc_no_answer_created_false_verify_banner_none
spec: 4. "no_verify_mail" — created is true, ... / 5. "no_answer" — error is "none" (the tenant gave no recognisable answer).

name: fc_no_answer_created_false_with_verify_mail_after
spec: 5. "no_answer" — error is "none" (the tenant gave no recognisable answer).

name: fc_other_wrong_password_created_false_no_mails
spec: 6. "other" — anything else.

name: fc_other_error_other_with_verify_mail
spec: 6. "other" — anything else.

name: fc_other_created_true_error_other_no_verify_banner
spec: 4. "no_verify_mail" — created is true, there is no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since, and error is "wrong_password" or "none" or verify_banner is true ... / 6. "other" — anything else.
